reviews.author: Chico Esteves
reviews.text: Force Air Inc We had Work done on our company fleet truck and I had a great experience with this mechanic. He was honest, knowledgeable, and took the time to explain exactly what was wrong with my truck. The work was completed professionally and on time, and my truck is running perfectly now. It’s hard to find someone you can trust, but he definitely earned my confidence. I highly recommend him to anyone looking for quality work and excellent service

reviews.author: Fatima Sanchez-Bohorquez
reviews.text: I’ve been bringing my cars to Complete Auto & Truck Repair for over 8 years now, and I truly can’t say enough good things about this place. From the moment I walk in the door, I’m always greeted warmly, the front desk lady is friendly, welcoming, and incredibly helpful. Rocco, Vinny, and Mike are honest, knowledgeable, and go above and beyond every time. Whether it’s routine maintenance, a last-minute issue, or getting my car ready for a long trip, they take care of everything with care and professionalism. I never feel rushed or talked down to, and they always make sure I leave with peace of mind. Every car my family and I have owned has been serviced here, and we wouldn’t trust anyone else. Thank you all for taking such great care of us year after year!

reviews.author: JUSTIN OK
reviews.text: One of the best mechanics in town, receptionist is really professional and made the whole process easy and smooth! I wish I can give them 10 stars. strongly recommend

reviews.author: V Francia
reviews.text: Rocco, the owner and mechanic of Complete Auto & Truck Repair provides all of his customers with outstanding customer service in all areas of how he and his team treats respectfully and kindly their clients as well as providing necessary auto engine/transmission needs (not pushing their clients with unnecessary costly engine/mechanic repairs. Thank you again Rocco and Team! I will refer to you as many prospective clients with any engine/transmission needs in the near future! Thank again! Vince

reviews.author: Alina Hernandez
reviews.text: Per a friend’s recommendation and finding out that my wife’s kids know Rocco and my wife goes to his sister Mecca, hairdresser for years. I just had to take my car to him. Two mechanics had not been able to figure out what was draining the battery. After two days Rocco, was able to figure it out. I am very pleased with the service and the pricing including towing of car. I would definitely keep returning to him and recommending anyone that has any car issues to him..This is my wife’s Google account but Im Edwin. I dealt with him and his team personally and very satisfied. Thank you Rocco !!!!

reviews.author: Gabriela Zhizhingo
reviews.text: Been with them for years now , they are always so easy to work with ! Pricing is always fair , & ALWAYS honest. I admit when I first started going I wasn’t sure but my cars have been in good hands this entire time . Love the front desk ( she’s a sweetheart ) the guys in the back I personally don’t know who’s who from names but they ALWAYS explain everything to me if I have a questions . They are always working !! One of my cars I bought a battery with them never an issue , got one for my other car with triple A& it’s a nightmare ! ( triple a battery has been on way less time then the one I got with complete ! ) regret not getting one for my other car with them but it was a needed in the moment time . Planning on staying with them for a longggg time for my cars.

reviews.author: Yesenia
reviews.text: Complete Auto & Truck Repair is truly a gem! Rocco, his dad Vinny, and the entire team go above and beyond to provide honest, high-quality service. From the moment you walk in, you feel like family. They take the time to explain everything clearly, give fair pricing, and never pressure you into unnecessary repairs. The work is always done efficiently, and I’ve never had to second-guess the quality, it’s top-notch every time. Whether it’s a quick fix like oil change or major repairs, I trust them completely. Thank you, Rocco, and the whole crew, for keeping my vehicle running smoothly and treating your customers with such care. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Beatriz Pagan
reviews.text: Have been a customer here for over 5 years for my vehicles and was recommended by my uncle who had been a customer for over 10 years himself. Mechanics are very knowledgeable and the prices are super fair. They are the most honest mechanics you will come across. I moved out of town 4 years ago and still bring my car to them because I trust them with all the maintenance of my vehicles. We have 3 cars and will not be bringing them elsewhere. Definitely a place I will continue to recommend. They take care of my babies as if they were theirs!

reviews.author: L Hernandez
reviews.text: My experiences with Complete Auto are always positive! Most recently I took my car in for an oil change and the shop was very busy. I was greeted promptly and my questions were addressed and my job was done on time. Mike completed the oil change and rotated the tires, Thank you Mike!! Thank you Complete Auto for your respect and excellent job!!

reviews.author: Tracy
reviews.text: The name Complete Auto & Truck Repair fits the business well with workers doing excellent work on your vehicle and no matter what type of work has to be done they will go far and beyond to get the job done. Fast and you're have your vehicle back in a timely manner. If I had to rate Complete Auto & Truck Repair from a score of 1 to 10, I would give them a perfect 10+. Even the secretary or the desk clerk that sits in front when you walk in have good manners and she would go way out her way to help you. So, keep up the good work Complete Auto & Truck Repair you will always have my vote.

reviews.author: Heather Grillo
reviews.text: Complete Auto once again puts my faith back in humanity with their honesty! Took my car in for a noise it was making. It was something simple they could fix on the spot and the price was a steal! These guys could have told me anything was wrong with the car and I would have let them go ahead and fix it and had a giant bill. But they chose to be honest! Won't ever take my cars anywhere else!

reviews.author: Andrew Clark
reviews.text: Title: Disappointing Experience with Head Gasket Repair I recently took my Jeep Cherokee to this mechanic for a head gasket replacement based on their recommendation. I was hopeful that this would resolve the issues I was facing. However, after the work was done, I noticed my car was shaking violently in the back. I returned to the mechanic to express my concerns, but the response was less than helpful. It seems like they either missed something or didn't do the job properly. Instead of fixing the problem, I feel like I now have an even bigger issue on my hands. I’m left feeling frustrated and regretting my choice to come here. I expected better service and expertise, especially for such a significant repair. I can't recommend this place to anyone needing reliable automotive work. Save your time and money and look elsewhere!

reviews.author: John Mascia
reviews.text: Rocco and his team of professional auto mechanics are top shelf; the best in the business! I have been using Complete Auto for several years… each time, my vehicles are repaired right the first time, at a reasonable and fare price and without delays! Getting an honest auto shop anywhere is like playing lotto; you always walk away feeling like a loser… broke, frustrated and always wondering… Rocco and his team at Compete Auto are stand up guys.. provide excellent service and you feel like a winner when you leave! You maintain your dignity, hard earned cash and know the job was done right!

reviews.author: Chris Gordon
reviews.text: Great service with a polite approach. Work was done in a timely fashion and all details were thoroughly explained. I would highly recommend Complete Auto and Truck Repair to friends, family, and anyone who needs service on the car/truck.

reviews.author: Eliza Montoya
reviews.text: I have been coming to Complete to get all of my cars fixed for many many years. Their level of service is unmatched. I get my car back quick and good as new! They are extremely accommodating always. I highly recommend Complete Auto & Truck Repair!

reviews.author: Carlos Herrera
reviews.text: I switched my mechanic for Rocco and his staff. Everyone there is knowledgeable on what they are doing and the outcome is amazing. Rocco tells you exactly what the problem is and does not give your the runaround

reviews.author: marcelo cunha
reviews.text: First time using his services. Unfair, unprofessional and unethical practices here. Don’t believe the good reviews. My truck is in another shop in Dover nj being fixed the right way.

reviews.author: Gary Smith
reviews.text: Most excellent experience with this shop on several occasions. This time, took car in for something that shop owner thought would fix the problem and it didn’t. He sent me packing with no bill because it was not the resolution. Will be returning for sure to have car service done.

reviews.author: Joanna Fonseca
reviews.text: Rocco and his team are always very professional and accommodating to my time and needs. He has very good mechanics that are honest and responsible.

reviews.author: Diana Darras
reviews.text: I took my car to Complete Auto & Truck Repair and it turned out the issue I was having was due to a leaf in the mass air flow sensor. It was removed and problem solved! Very difficult to find an honest mechanic. I highly recommend them because they always do a great job, even & especially when the problem is more then a leaf. Check them out, great customer service every time!

reviews.author: Jae Awesome
reviews.text: I'm never disappointed with the work. This is the only shop that I trust with my vehicle. They are honest and definitely go up and beyond what is needed.

reviews.author: Chris D. Tomea
reviews.text: Complete Auto & Truck Repair is the best shop around...it's like having my family take care of my car...the trust goes without saying!!! Honest upfront about everything...really treat their customers like family!!! Keep up the great work Rocco and Vincent!!!

reviews.author: Keith Wyble
reviews.text: Complete Auto does it all for my cars. They always take care in the jobs they do. I have never had to come back because something was not right. There isn’t anything they can’t do. I have been going to them for many years and I will continue to do so

reviews.author: Christopher Espinosa
reviews.text: Left my truck for 3 weeks and they never touched it , when I asked for a status, tells me parts are hard to find.. after 3 weeks

reviews.author: DeAna Colon
reviews.text: They've always been honest with what work is/isn't needed on my cars. Prices are reasonable and service is great too!

reviews.author: Daren Venable
reviews.text: Great customer service and a quick turn around time. I will definitely return if/when my car needs servicing again.

reviews.author: Jose A. Rodriguez
reviews.text: I have been taking all my family cars there for about 7 years. Hard to find a good mechanic shop that is trustworthy this is by far the best one I have been to great prices and great service!!!!!

reviews.author: Daniel Sullivan
reviews.text: Rocco helped me big time with my AC compressor, saving me hundreds of dollars! I’ll be taking my business back there and recommending them!

reviews.author: Bazz Cartagena Jr
reviews.text: A+++++++. Services. Definitely recommend to all with vehicles new or old They’ll get it done for the right price.

reviews.author: Heather Grillo
reviews.text: Once again, nothing but the best at Complete! Rocco and his crew are honest and go above and beyond!

reviews.author: diego rugari
reviews.text: number one. in no time they accommodated my car . qualified and very competent . I recommend it to everyone.

reviews.author: Good Tidings Plumbing Heating Cooling
reviews.text: Fantastic Company who cares about their customers and goes above and beyond to be helpful. Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Eliceo Paredes
reviews.text: Thank you, very professional people. I feel safe driving my car there. Great people and very kind. I recommend them 100%.
